name: p10gqj-notification-stall
goal: A failing HTTP target cannot stall native Tracker notifications

evidence: A thrown native Tracker notification send stayed in flight and replayed every tick, so no other delivery ran. Expected: a failed attempt with backoff, cap, stored error, one safe log line. Reproduced with a fake loopback endpoint (HTTP 500, dropped socket).

tracker-attention-delivery and verifyParkedReminderRetry asserted that the tick rejects and replays after a lost acknowledgement; none kept a target failing beside a second target. Added reusable fake-endpoint cases through trackerNodeNotifications.
